title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.1.4.220
body_markdown:
### Added

* New tool window "GitHub Copilot" to replace the split editor of the "Open Copilot" feature.

### Fixed

* Don't show completions when IdeaVIM is used and the editor is in normal mode.
